/extensions/mode_replay.note: Every recipe was replayed against the ROM in wpc-emu and its verification recorded per mode; not run on hardware.

/extensions/sound_commands.note: Runtime-verified protocol; per-command annotations are contributor observations.

/memory_map.note: tomlogic's map unchanged except the two extensions below.

/memory_map/adjustments/A.2 Feature Adju.note: Two entries (0x0C, 0x11) were changed in the emulator and behaved as named; the rest rest on the descriptor and string alignment. What 0x04 BALL SAVE TIME does was not established: the save never armed in the emulator.

/memory_map/player_state.note: Raw game recordings retained (rammap/rec/); Super Jets and attack-wave formulas were prediction-checked.

addressing.basis: PinMAME's WPC-95 NVRAM handler saves wpc_ram from 0x0000 for 0x3000 bytes, so the image index is the CPU address; confirmed live on VPinMAME (847 Controller.NVRAM polls).

bits.caveat: established for the lock-started multiball only
both run at 0x83; this word cannot separate them

mode_word.encoding: bit array; stacked modes OR together, so a whole-word label is only valid when no second mode can produce the same value
mode_word.method: Two shared routines write this word: 0xC5B4 sets bits, 0xC568 clears them, so the writing PC identifies nothing. The mode is named by hooking the CPU read path and recording which string it walks in the English text bank (bank 28) within 600 ms of the write.

signatures.note: set in four consecutive writes: hi 0x18, lo 0x1C, lo +0x20, lo +0x83. It is 0x183C or 0x0083, so this value cannot be distinguished from Total Annihilation stacked on Martian Attack by the word alone; only the ROM text separates them.
lo bits 2-5 in one write plus hi bits 3-4

steps.note: 3-bank right; bank motor drops the shield
shoot the saucer once per required hit; the count is at 0x0889 and 0x088A counts down, so repeat this step until 0x088A reads 0
repeat the relight+lock pair three times; the third lock starts multiball
one alien per group; >= 2 s apart or hits are lost
right orbit complete; repeat all four lanes three times, 12 shots, any order
round-robin 53/54/55, 100 hits total, each switch every 150 ms
entry then exit only; a return-lane hit breaks the chain

notes: A recipe is an ordered step list. Feed each `sw` to Controller.Switch(n) for `hold` ms, wait `gap` ms, next step.

Steps written as an `op` are mechanical rather than a plain closure: a ball arriving in the saucer, the left popper or the right scoop, where the script must also clear the opto when the kick solenoid fires.
A recipe carries a PRECONDITION. Run one with requires.mode_word 0 while a multiball is up and the identical closures score jackpots instead of starting the mode.
No RAM write reaches the machine on stock VPinMAME, so switch closures are the only way in short of patching the ROM.

ops.ball: ensure one ball is in play; serve and plunge if not
ops.clear: drain until the running-mode word at 0x0294/0x0295 reads 0, so the recipe starts from ordinary play
ops.lockpopper: ball arrives at the left popper: Switch(36)=0, then =1 when solenoid 3 fires
ops.saucer: ball enters the mothership saucer (sw78 closed 120 ms), ROM kicks it to the left popper
ops.scoop: ball arrives at the right scoop: Switch(37)=0, then =1 when solenoid 4 fires

timing.why: measured on the jets in 20-hit batches: 2 ms closed registers 0/20, 4 ms registers 19/20; 100 ms between closures of the same switch registers 19/20, 120 ms registers 20/20
